title: The Nine's message: surveillance of Earth, wars and nuclear weapons

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, speaking on a podcast, describes messages from "The Nine", a group said to be a council of non-human beings who spoke through people in recorded sessions held from the 1950s at the Round Table Foundation, a small research group in Maine. According to Malatzi, The Nine said they had been watching Earth and seeing the bad things happening here, especially wars and nuclear weapons. He draws on the transcripts of those sessions, and the story matters to those who tell it because it would mean someone out there is monitoring humanity's capacity to destroy itself.
